rule: Pass when the median paired change in output-token throughput and in median TPOT, logging on versus off, is within 5%, and the unobserved runs' range is within 10% of their median for both metrics. Fail when the median paired change exceeds 5% in the costly direction and at least 4 of 5 pairs agree. Otherwise inconclusive. Every run must revalidate complete from its raw evidence, with all requests finished; the pressure workload must preempt on both sides, and each observed run's engine counter must equal its history.
